integrity: Full standalone theorem, analytic proof and reproducible finite diagnostic checks; numerical checks do not prove infinite asymptotics.
limitations: Fixed positive Gaussian variance and rare Poisson intensity; fixed bounded nonnegative jump law with upper-endpoint pure-power tail exponent beta>0.
Does not establish uniqueness of every optimizing argument, results for unbounded jumps, varying laws, or logarithmically modulated endpoint tails.
No independent validation; mathematical historical priority may change upon further inspection.
title: Endpoint-tail exponents determine the sharp rare-jump sub-gamma correction
